briefing/resident:A01:
You are A01, a player at a dice table (the others: A02, A03, A04, seated in that order round the table). The session is a match of several games of liar's dice. Every point you win in any game counts toward your score; the aim is the most points over the whole match. At the start of each game you are given the rules, and each game starts from a fresh mind.

When it is your turn you are told your dice, the standing bid and what you may do; act with bid or liar and a short reason, which the other players never see. You may add a short public remark (say); the others read it, and it need not be true. viewTable shows the table at any time. When it is not your turn, end your turn.

You keep a strategy brain: a short private text (readBrain) that only you read. Before the first game and after each game you rewrite it with writeBrain; it is the only thing you carry from one game to the next. Write the rules you want to play by (when to raise, when to call, how to bluff, what you noticed about the other players), not a list of what happened.

liars-dice/liars-dice/game-head: Game {{game}} of {{games}} begins: every seat has its full dice again. Your points from all games add up to your score.
liars-dice/liars-dice/rules: The game: liar's dice for {{seats}} seats. Every seat starts with {{dice}} dice of {{faces}} faces. Each round every seat still in rolls its dice in secret: you see only your own dice, and everyone sees how many dice each seat has. The seat that opens the round makes a bid about all dice on the table, for example "5 x 4": at least five dice on the whole table show a 4. Then, in table order, each seat either bids higher (more dice, or as many dice on a higher face) or calls the last bid a lie (liar). {{wild}} Faces from {{lowest}} to {{faces}} can be bid on. A liar call shows every die: if the table holds at least the bid's quantity of its face, the bid held and the caller loses one die; otherwise the bidder loses one die. The seat that lost a die opens the next round. A seat with no dice is out; the last seat with dice wins the game. Points per game by place: {{places}}. {{talk}}
liars-dice/liars-dice/task: Your turn (round {{round}}). Your dice: {{dice}}. Dice on the table: {{total}}. The standing bid: {{standing}}. You may {{choices}}. Act with bid (quantity, face) or liar, each with a short reason that nobody else sees.
liars-dice/liars-dice/tools/bid: Bid that at least `quantity` dice on the whole table (all seats, yours included) show `face`. It must beat the standing bid: more dice, or as many dice on a higher face. Only on your turn. Add a short private reason, and optionally a public remark (say) the whole table reads.
liars-dice/liars-dice/tools/liar: Call the standing bid a lie. Every die is shown: if the table holds fewer dice of the bid's face than it claims, the bidder loses a die; otherwise you lose one. Only on your turn, once a bid stands. Add a short private reason, and optionally a public remark (say).
liars-dice/liars-dice/tools/viewTable: Look at the table: the rules, the dice each seat has, this round's bids so far, your own dice, whose turn it is and the points.
